snippet.title: the silence official trailer
snippet.description: A short game about domestic abuse based on a very difficult time in my life.  In the game, you will see how abuse affects someone, the emotions they feel, and how it slowly destroys them.  While surviving an abusive relationship was very hard for me, the hardest part was admitting to myself that I was a victim.  Amazing vocals by MreeMusic https://www.youtube.com/user/mreebee3
